fields.name: name
fields.description: The achievement: a key of `G.achievements` with a `count`.

fields.name: count
fields.description: The count now (`item.acc`). For `festive` (damage) and `gooped` (attack values) it is a sum, so it can have a fraction.

confirm.note: `name` and `needed`: the achievements of G with a `count` (abtesting 1000, firehazard 20000, stomped 1200, gooped 60000000 with `rr` 40000, festive 400000); `reflector` (node/server.js:3797-3800) is not in G, so it returns early.

senders.what: `item_achievement_increment`: the count passes a multiple of `G.achievements[name].rr` (1 when absent) and is still below `needed`.
`abtesting` (the equipped `orb`): you kill a player of the other team in A/B Testing.
`stomped` (the `helmet`): a hit from `stompy` when it has no target. A hit from another monster resets the count. `gooped` (the `pants`): the `attack` value of each hit from `goo` or `cgoo`.
`firehazard` (the `mainhand`): a burn tick kills a monster. A last hit of another kind resets the count.
